name: autofix-web
description: Frontend (TypeScript/React) fix pipeline: a frontend-fixer agent writes the fix under web/, gated by its OWN check (npm install && npm run build / tsc --noEmit), then publishes the commit to the PR branch. The web sibling of `autofix` — no Go test-auditor, since the guard is .ts/.tsx and the gate is a type-check/build. Inputs {task, namespace, repo, ref, number}.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: the pull request number this fix belongs to (provenance)

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "${inputs.ref}"; git rev-parse HEAD > /workspace/.fixbase; echo "working on branch ${inputs.ref}:"; git log --oneline -1

set +e; export HOME=/tmp; [ -n "$NUM" ] || { echo 'no PR number; skip announce'; exit 0; }; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; RID=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '
' | grep ""name":"$REPO"" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' | head -1); mkdir -p /tmp/jw; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/jw/main.go; cd /tmp/jw && printf 'module jw

go 1.25
' > go.mod; FIRST=$(printf '%s' "$TASK" | head -1); printf '🔧 **Fixing:** %s

The commits below address this finding.' "$FIRST" > /tmp/body.txt; go run . /tmp/body.txt > /tmp/body.json; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/body.json || echo 000); echo "announce -> $code"; exit 0

export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; BASE=$(cat /workspace/.fixbase 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse "origin/${inputs.ref}"); echo '=== STAT ==='; git diff --stat "$BASE" HEAD; echo '=== DIFF ==='; git diff "$BASE" HEAD | head -450

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; REF='${inputs.ref}'; BASE=$(git rev-parse "origin/$REF"); if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE" ]; then echo 'no fix commits -- nothing to push'; fixed=0; export fixed; echo "fixed=$fixed"; exit 0; fi; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$REF; echo "pushed the fix to $REF"; fixed=1; export fixed; echo "fixed=$fixed"

set +e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; [ -n "$NUM" ] || { echo 'no PR number; skip done'; exit 0; }; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; RID=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '
' | grep ""name":"$REPO"" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' | head -1); SHA=$(cd /workspace && git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ "$FIXED" = "1" ]; then printf '✅ **Fixed** — pushed `%s` (commits above).' "$SHA" > /tmp/body.txt; else printf '⚠️ **No change** for this finding — the autofixer could not resolve it.' > /tmp/body.txt; fi; mkdir -p /tmp/jw; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/jw/main.go; cd /tmp/jw && printf 'module jw

go 1.25
' > go.mod; go run . /tmp/body.txt > /tmp/body.json; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/body.json || echo 000); echo "done -> $code"; exit 0
